items.q: Should firing your gun stop a sprint, the way aiming already does?
items.note: Aiming already cuts the sprint, as you ordered; firing does not.

items.q: While you bandage or use a medkit, how should you move?
items.note: Today you heal at full speed.

items.q: What should an explosion right next to you do to your pillager?
opts: A stagger that throws off aim
items.note: Per-gun kicks and hit shoves stay, as you chose.

items.q: What should taking a hit do to your sprint?
Should taking a hit stop a bandage or medkit you are using?
opts: Only a big hit stops it
items.note: Today only going down stops a heal.

items.q: Should a heavy hit nudge your aim off target for a moment?
opts: A small nudge on big hits
items.note: Today hits shake the screen but never move your aim.

items.q: Should sprinting pause a reload until you stop?
items.note: Today a reload keeps going while you sprint.

items.q: When you are downed, should you be able to shoot while you crawl?
items.note: Today a downed pillager can crawl and extract, but not shoot.

items.q: How should the crowbar swing work?
opts: Third swing in a row hits hardest
items.note: Melee one-shots crawlers and breaks walls today.

items.q: What should a finisher on a downed pillager bot give you?
opts: Ammo for the gun in hand

items.q: Your half-second warnings cover the bulwark, warden, Overseer and air strikes, as you chose. Should the elite longshot bot's big shot join that list with a glint?
opts: No, heavy machines only, as now
items.note: It hits for 272 from long range.

items.q: Should shotguns load one shell at a time, so you can fire before the reload ends?
items.note: Every gun reloads in one go today.

items.q: Should a decoy beacon also pull the Overseer away?
Should a thrown grenade bounce off walls?
opts: No, it stops at the wall
Yes, it bounces until it rests
items.note: Today a throw stops at the first wall in its path.

items.q: Should holding fire on a single-shot gun keep firing at its top rate?
items.note: Automatic guns already fire while held.

items.q: Should you be able to throw back a grenade a pillager bot lands at your feet?
items.note: Pillager bots carry and throw frags today.

items.q: Should the scav pistol from the freebie kit never run out of ammo?
opts: No, it uses ammo, as now
items.note: It is the spawn-only last resort gun.

items.q: Should a round hitting a far wall make a noise machines can hear there?
opts: No, only the shot is heard
items.note: Today machines hear the shot where it is fired.

items.q: Should reloading an empty gun take longer than topping up a part-full one?
opts: No, the same time, as now
items.note: Rounds left in the magazine are kept either way.

items.q: When a heavy machine you cannot see is about to fire at you, how should you be warned?
opts: A red streak at your feet
items.note: Seen heavies warn half a second ahead, as you chose.

items.q: What should the golden enemy do when it gets hurt?
items.note: A golden enemy shows up every raid with big loot.

items.q: If nobody hunts the golden enemy, should it leave the map after a while?
opts: Yes, gone after a few minutes

items.q: What should badly hurt pillager bots do?
In two-player raids, who should the Overseer go after?
Should a few more machines start asleep, so you can sneak past or ambush them?
opts: No, only the listener, as now
items.note: Today only the listener lies dormant until it hears you.

items.q: When machines attack, what should nearby pillager bots do?
opts: Call a short truce with you
items.note: Machines and pillager bots already fight each other.

items.q: Should a machine wreck block shots, so you can use it as cover?
items.note: Wrecks stay today and you can search them, but they do not block shots.

items.q: How should pillager bots react to a grenade landing near them?
items.note: Today bots ignore your grenades; they only dodge mortar rings.

items.q: Should a warden or bulwark open up for a moment right after it fires its big shot?
items.note: Today you hit a warden in the back and flank a bulwark.

items.q: Should machines go after a downed pillager?
opts: No, machines ignore the downed, as now
Crawling draws them, lying still hides

items.q: Should a new stalker machine shadow you just outside your sight, closing in when you look away?
items.note: Today the listener is the only machine that ambushes.

items.q: Should the forge sit in the same spot every raid, or move?
Should the forge have machines guarding it?
opts: No, it is a safe spot

items.q: Before you extract, should you be able to swap a forge element for $?
opts: No, the pick is final, as now
items.note: An extracted forge gun keeps its element forever, as you chose.

items.q: Should the forge also upgrade the crowbar, with its own element?
Should elite pillager bots sometimes carry an element gun you can take?
items.note: Today only a MK III forge gun carries an element.

items.q: Should a door key be used up when it opens its room, or kept for later raids?
items.note: Keys are rare loot that open the locked rooms.

items.q: Should the crowbar force a locked room open without a key, slowly and loudly?
items.note: The crowbar breaks other walls today, but never a keyed door.

items.q: When you look at a gun on the floor, should it show its damage next to the gun in your hands?
Should you be able to break a spare gun into crafting parts?
Should you be able to craft at a bench up top during a raid?
Should you choose where you ascend on the map?
items.note: Today you ascend at a random one of about ten spots.

items.q: Should every ascend spot have some easy loot in sight, so the first minute pays?
Should the soft night light around you give you away to machines, with a switch to turn it off?
items.note: Today a soft light always surrounds you at night; machines cannot see it.

items.q: Should a lightning bolt hurt machines too?
items.note: Today a bolt only hurts players, and its crack draws machines.

items.q: Should some machines walk fixed patrol routes you can learn and time?
Should kills on hot ground pay more SP?
opts: No, richer crates only, as now

items.q: In the last minute, should the map show the burn coming, with falling ash and a red glow?
opts: Yes, ash and a red glow
No, the red clock is enough
items.note: The last 60 s already bring a sting and a red clock.

items.q: Should opening a vault set off an alarm that brings a wave?
Should the map hide one safe room that machines never enter?
Should a pillager bot crew sometimes hold an extract ring you must clear first?
Besides the bounty pillager bot event, should a second machine boss roam far from the Overseer, with its own loot?
Should doorways have doors you can shut, so machines must break through?
items.note: Locked rooms already need a key.

items.q: While you watch your partner after extracting, can you still ping danger for them?
items.note: The first one out watches the partner live, as you chose.

items.q: After you extract, should you be able to call one supply drop for your partner?
When your partner joins a run that is already going, where should they ascend?
Besides the team combo, should two players near each other get anything more?
opts: A supply drop for the pair
No, the team combo is enough
items.note: In the demo the team combo pays for kills made close together.

items.q: Should reviving your partner use up a bandage?
items.note: Partners can revive each other any number of times, as you chose.

items.q: How much health should a revived partner come back with?
Should the bleed-out clock pause while your partner is reviving you?
items.note: Today the 17 s clock keeps running while your partner revives you.

items.q: When your partner goes down, should you get a short burst of speed to reach them?
When your downed partner has 5 s left, should a sharper alert sound?
How should a downed partner get to cover?
opts: You can carry them at walking pace

items.q: Your partner's row shows name, health, armour and the down timer. Should it also show their ammo?
Should you be able to see what your partner carries in their backpack?
Should a medal reward reviving your partner under fire?
items.note: Today no medal rewards helping your partner.

items.q: When your partner is dead or extracted, should the pillager still up top get tougher for a while?
items.note: Your SP never depends on your partner, as you chose.

items.q: One sprint row sets hold or toggle for keys and pad. Should pads start on toggle, keys on hold?
items.note: Today hold is the default for both.

items.q: On keyboard, how should you roll?
opts: The roll key only, as now

items.q: F brings up the next gun on the bar. Should it go back to the gun you held last instead?
Should the mouse wheel step through your guns instead of zooming?
Should the big map stay open only while you hold M?
opts: Press to open and close, as now

items.q: Should the pad buzz when a machine spots you?
items.note: Today the pad buzzes on hits, going down and near blasts.

items.q: Should your roll go where you move, or where you aim?
items.note: Standing still, you roll the way you face.

items.q: Should pressing fire during a reload stop it, so you shoot the rounds still in the gun?
Should Settings offer a tap instead of a hold for extract and revive?
items.note: Looting stays a hold, as you ordered.

items.q: Should the crosshair dim when your target is out of your gun's range?
items.note: Today a round simply stops at the gun's range.

items.q: Should Settings offer a clean view that hides most of the HUD?
items.note: Today you can drag HUD panels and fold them.

items.q: Should Settings let players turn off the faint aim line?
items.note: The dotted line from your gun is always on today, as you chose.

items.q: Should Settings have a switch to turn blood off?
items.note: Players bleed a little today.

items.q: Should alarms and warnings get their own volume row in Settings?
How should the game warn that your magazine is nearly empty?
opts: Add a lighter click near empty
items.note: Today the magazine ring turns amber, then red, and pulses.

items.q: Should regular machines show a health bar, or only smoke and sparks?
opts: Smoke and sparks only, as now
items.note: Machines smoke at half health and spark near death today.

items.q: Should fast hits on one enemy merge into one growing damage number?
items.note: Today each hit shows its own number.

items.q: Should damage you take show as red numbers over your pillager?
opts: No, the health bar is enough

items.q: Should the kill feed show the gun or element that got the kill?
opts: Yes, a small gun or element icon

items.q: How should your pillager show armour wearing down in a raid?
opts: Plates fall off as they break

items.q: How should enemy shots look next to your own?
opts: Enemy tracers in a warning colour

items.q: When a machine slips out of sight, should a fading mark show where you last saw it?
opts: No, out of sight is gone

items.q: Should a faint ring show how far your own steps and shots carry?
items.note: Red rings already show unseen sounds within earshot.

items.q: Should the KIA card replay the last few seconds before you went down?
Contracts pay $ plus gear today, and a gun on hard and elite. Should the big ones also pay a cosmetic?
Should the three full sets also drop as rare loot up top?
opts: Yes, rare finds you must extract
items.note: Today: skeleton 12 extractions, trooper level 8, android 30 runs.

items.q: Should the Undercroft get a small shooting range to try guns?
What should happen to a hired merc who survives the raid?
opts: They leave; hire fresh, as now
They stay for a fee each raid
items.note: Today a hire lasts one raid; safe extractions make them cheaper.

items.q: Should you be able to hand your hire a gun from your stash before the raid?
Should a ping send your hire to that spot?
opts: No, the three orders are enough
items.note: Today O cycles loot, follow and hold.

items.q: Should career offer an optional hardcore save where one death wipes the stash?
items.note: Death already empties what you carried.

items.q: Night already pays 20 percent more XP, as you chose. Should it also pay more $?
items.note: Night also brings more machines.

items.q: The codex lists the guns you have found. Should it also list each machine you have destroyed, with its picture and your kill count?
